description: Named variables of the Stalker's behaviour (chara/Stalker/behavior.lua reads and writes them by name). Each character instance owns a small block of bytes; every entry of "fields" names one value in it: "name" is the name the script uses, "kind" the storage type (s8, u8, s16, u16, s32, u32: a write keeps the low bits, a read sign- or zero-extends), "at" the byte offset in the block (absent: the next naturally aligned offset), "note" what the value means. Values are raw integers in the units the behaviour uses (usually Q12, 4096 = 1.0 or 1 m; angles Q12, 4096 = a full turn). A mod adds or changes fields with a state.json of the same path; keep the offsets of fields the behaviour already uses.

fields.name: stalker_step_x
fields.note: Extra step of this tick on top of move_speed (lunges, grabs, recoils).

fields.name: stalker_target_x
fields.note: Where the stalker last knew Harry to be.

fields.name: stalker_blend_from
fields.note: The pose a blend starts from: a keyframe of the previous clip (or its status) and the offset into the next.

fields.name: stalker_stagger_damage
fields.note: Damage taken recently; past the difficulty's threshold the stalker staggers.
